notes: V3.3 — The Attuned Companion. A new Adaptive Practice Engine reads your own check-ins (mood, voice, stillness) and offers a transparent “Attuned to you” recommendation with a plain-language reason and one-tap start. Plus: a ⌘K command palette for fast navigation, a Signal Trends view that mirrors how you've been arriving over time, and a felt “coherence bloom” when your breathing settles in-session. Accessibility deepened (a main landmark, fully labeled controls) with an automated a11y check now in CI. Everything stays on your device.
